# Goal
Kotodama round 52, attempt 1 (hyaku phase 3, 2026-10-22): residual attack call of 8 reviewer/critic seats (the 32-64 seat build wave was refused twice by the fleet seat gate: timeouts at 3600 s and 1800 s). Lane repo /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kotodama-shokunin, branch main (jj-colocated). Read /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kotodama-shokunin/reports/round-52/claims.json first. Commits: prerequisite `147cfde` (QUALITY criterion 10, tools/check-source-access.py, S094 status mined -> rejected with superseding row S132, S133 superseding S097's locator); declaration `d9f73c8`; claim D landed `dea5ece` (sign-language entry corpus/knowledge/linguistics/sign-languages-manual-modality.md: lines citing S094 5 -> 0, details re-cited to S096 and S097). Claim C (a new speech-surrogates entry) is being written by the L1 and is NOT in scope for you unless your item says so.

# Bounds
You are a leaf: no delegation, no background jobs. Read-only: write ONLY your report at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kotodama-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-52/residual/<YourSeatName>.md (absolute path). Never edit, create or delete any other file in the lane, a sibling lane, or the fleet repo /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin. Never run any jj command at the fleet root /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin; in the lane only read-only jj with --ignore-working-copy. Never run git add/commit/stash/checkout/switch/reset/pull/push or any mutating jj command; read-only git (log, show, diff, status) is fine. Scratch only under /fast/scratch/hyaku/kotodama-r52/<YourSeatName>.
Sources by ORDINARY MEANS ONLY (plain requests, read tool, curl, Wayback captures, open repositories). NEVER a headless browser or any tool that gets past a bot challenge, captcha, paywall or login (QUALITY criterion 10). Quote at most 25 words with location; never invent a source, quote or page.
Tooling: you may install tools that help; read /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md first and record tool, version, channel and reason. All pacman transactions are PAUSED host-wide: never pacman -S/-Sy/-Syu/-U/-R, never downgrade, never restart a host service. Prefer no installs.

# Output
A concise Markdown report: item, verdict first (HOLDS, HOLDS-WITH-FIXES or FAILS), evidence (path:line, command and output, URL and quote), concrete fixes. Plain English; no run-together words, no private jargon. Author-lane advice, never admission.
